issue.title: Fold sase artifact create --bead into bead note attachments

task_type_fields.proposal: Decide whether sase artifact create --bead should create a bead note attachment (content-addressed snapshot, private store, badges) instead of or in addition to an artifact link. Then migrate or alias the flag so there is one way to put a file on a bead.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-1ck added attachments without changing the artifact CLI. Merging the two models affects artifact retention, links, and existing users, so it needs its own design.

issue.creation_reason: sase-1ck.10 (ga phase of epic sase-1ck) proposed this follow-up, and the epic plan listed it as one. There are now two overlapping ways to associate files with a bead.
